purpose: Independent real publisher article reference for comparing the PSD collection in PostgreSQL. No generated articles or production observations are included.
annotation_policy: Positive associations are manually grounded in publisher editorial text returned by the web reader or indexed publisher-body results. Search summaries alone, related links, tags and comments do not establish a match. Only assessed_target_keys may contribute to association precision; unassessed names are unknown.
limitations: Convenience sample of 40 real URLs across ten publishers and all 24 approved people; neither statistically representative nor complete by person, source, date or event.

All verification was mediated by web page opening or indexed publisher editorial text. This does not prove direct collector access, successful extraction, production storage or freshness of a cached page.

Three J3News dates come from publisher URL paths corroborated by event timing, without an explicit publication timestamp in the returned article. Publication dates remain UNVERIFIED and eligible_for_strict_date_evaluation=false. Evaluate the 37 visible-date cases separately; do not relax the checker whitelist to include these three.
Verified public addresses are lookup keys, not assertions about rel=canonical. One O Dia URL is an AMP address; unverified non-AMP aliases were not invented.
Only five explicit negative person associations were assessed across four articles. A low error rate here cannot establish corpus-wide precision; all other unlisted people are unassessed.
Some separate URLs report the same event or campaign, so 40 URLs do not mean 40 independent news events.

No verified O Globo, G1, Extra or CBN article was added in this bounded research. O Globo access was blocked by the web reader and useful G1 results were not returned. This is a reference coverage gap, not evidence that those outlets published no relevant news.
One source is Câmara Municipal do Rio institutional reporting and must remain distinguishable from nine independent news publishers.
No collection was started and no production articles, recall measurements or readiness gates are claimed by this file.
